Style Guide

  • CURIE: gmeow:StyleGuide
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/StyleGuide
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/norms
  • Box roles: TBox role (What is this?)

The voice payload of a persona or register — prose whose REGISTER IS THE CONTENT. The prose-voice doctrine (gap analysis): voice documents attach byte-perfect via gmeow:exemplifiedBy (content-digested Documents carrying gmeow:hasAboutness gmeow:aboutnessEnacts — the document does not describe the voice, it IS the voice), never shredded into pseudo-quantified style triples. Style dimensions, when stated, are prose.

Structure

Subclass of: gmeow:InformationObject

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:StyleGuide as a specialized kind of gmeow:InformationObject. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:InformationObject

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use for the voice payload of a persona or register — prose whose register IS the content, exemplified byte-perfect by enacting documents.

Avoid when

  • Avoid shredding voice into pseudo-quantified style triples (style dimensions, when stated, are prose) and avoid an exemplar document that merely describes the voice — it must enact it (gmeow:aboutnessEnacts).

How to use

  • Mint the guide, name what it voices with gmeow:styleGuideFor, and attach byte-perfect enacting documents via gmeow:exemplifiedBy (each carrying gmeow:contentDigest and gmeow:hasAboutness gmeow:aboutnessEnacts).

Examples

  • ex:clinicalVoice a gmeow:StyleGuide; gmeow:styleGuideFor ex:drChen; gmeow:exemplifiedBy ex:sampleNote.
